dialogues.speaker: Bricole
dialogues.text: Just being kicked out of the Fontaine Research Institute didn't bring him to his senses. He really is pigheaded.

dialogues.speaker: Bricole
dialogues.text: But nobody is backing him now, so you can relax. He can't cause any more trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Bricole
dialogues.text: It's puzzling, isn't it? It seems like he's made... uh... various modifications to this place.

dialogues.speaker: Bricole
dialogues.text: Now it feels more suited to some ancient ruins that tourists might visit... Although perhaps it isn't too prudent to say it like that.

dialogues.speaker: Bricole
dialogues.text: *ahem* The aforementioned viewpoint is only my personal opinion, and is not representative of the Fontaine Research Institute or its viewpoints.

dialogues.speaker: Bricole
dialogues.text: *sigh* This place starts to feel scary if you're alone here for too long...

dialogues.speaker: Bricole
dialogues.text: I don't know either. I don't recall anyone by that name at the Fontaine Research Institute... Perhaps, as far as he's concerned, it's better that nobody by that name exists?

dialogues.speaker: Bricole
dialogues.text: Just like he said himself, Kuisel was just a convenient character. The more different that character was from himself, the better, as it made it less likely anyone would recognize him... Although that's just a guess of mine.

dialogues.speaker: Bricole
dialogues.text: *sigh* If you ask me, though, I think he changed enough over the years as it is. I didn't recognize him at first.
